thumbs.title: Helios trades 1.5x below peers; our analyses support $45–55 per share
Fundamental analyses support $45–55 per share, a 6–29% premium to the current $42.50
Core peers trade at a median 9.9x 2025E EBITDA vs. 9.2x for Helios
Revenue has compounded at 6% since 2019 with a 270bp margin uplift; the plan adds 7% a year
60% of revenue is earned outside North America, served from 47 sites in 24 countries
Each 50bp of WACC moves DCF value by c.$5 per share; the base case implies $50.88
Precedent deals were struck at a median 10.3x LTM EBITDA and a 37% premium to the 30-day VWAP
A two-stage auction can deliver signing by end-March 2027 and closing in July
